# Generated tables (explore/tukey_h/summarise.py; do not edit by hand)

Seeds: [0, 1, 2, 3, 4]. Each cell is a median over seeds; brackets are [min, max] over seeds. Ratios are paired per seed on tail-ESS/grad (coordinate-mean tail-ESS divided by all gradients, warm-up included). 'Worst' ratios use worst-coordinate tail-ESS per gradient. Tail-prob error is |P_hat(x_i < q_p) - p| / 0.01 averaged over coordinates and p in {0.01, 0.99}; MCSE is the same quantity's Monte Carlo standard error (indicator ESS).
